title: Webtoon 'Villains Are Destined to Die' Gets TV Anime
content: Publishing company Kakao Piccoma announced a television anime adaptation of Gyeoeul Gwon ’s Villains Are Destined to Die webtoon on Sunday, revealing a visual commemorating the conclusion of the main story (pictured above). Gwon penned the original web novel on the KakaoPage website from March 2019 to August 2020.

title: 5 Most Shocking Deaths in Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2
content: Jujutsu Kaisen is a shonen series that has built a reputation for standing out from what the genre is typically known for.
